schema.description: Exactly one of destinationPostalPrefix or pickupPointId is required (ADR 0027).

destinationPostalPrefix.description: Destination postal prefix (never a full address).

pickupPointId.description: The pickup point to quote to; the point's own prefix becomes the destination prefix and its serving station the wave's station (ADR 0027).

lines.description: One line on a product page, the cart's lines at checkout.

tiers.description: Tiers to quote; the four classic tiers (SAME_DAY, NEXT_DAY, TWO_DAY, STANDARD) when omitted. CONSOLIDATED is returned only when it is listed here or consolidatedDeliveryDay is present (ADR 0024).

items.description: Service tier (promise.Tier). CONSOLIDATED is the opt-in tier of a customer-chosen delivery day (ADR 0024): a quote returns it only when its request lists it or names consolidatedDeliveryDay, so a caller that never asks never sees it.
items.title: Tier

consolidatedDeliveryDay.description: The calendar date the shopper wants the order delivered on, as a local date of the destination delivery station's time zone (ADR 0024). Naming it adds the CONSOLIDATED tier to the quote. A day earlier than the fastest feasible window is moved up to that window (the offer then has consolidationEligible false); with tiers listing CONSOLIDATED and no day, the day is two local days after the fastest window. A day more than 14 local days from now, or without a wave, has no CONSOLIDATED offer: the tier is reported in unavailable.
